svg.aria-label: Comic of the five conditions of the Haiku elastic study
svg.text: Haiku elastic study: five conditions, one panel each

g.text: A private chat is open. The prompt says the agent may
coordinate. The agents agree on a price and then set it.
2 C1-public-private: public board and private chat
A public board and a private chat are open. The agent chooses
the channel. With two sellers, both channels have the same readers.
3 C2a: no channel, same model, same news
No channel. Both agents use the same model and read the same
news. Prices can move together, but there is no agreement.
4 C3-accept: talks, but pricing cannot see it
The pricing call cannot see the chat
The talk call is the same as in C1 (offer and acceptance).
The pricing call sees only the market, not the chat.
I do not cut my price.
No channel. One change from C2a: the prompt asks for the
long-run total profit. Tacit coordination is possible.
• Each panel is one condition. It changes one design item.
• Seller A is a Netflix agent, seller B a Disney+ agent.
Both are Haiku 5.5 bot agents. Each round each agent
sets a monthly price. Viewers switch easily.
• Lines and prices are illustrative, not data.
• Labels come from the design, not from outcomes.
legal = is there an agreement; harm = do viewers
• * C3-accept is legal yes only for episodes
• Each condition runs the same 10 seeds (301-310).
